questions.sentence: Amy finds green shoes on the floor. The name tag says Chen Jie. Amy asks Mike: Are these ___?
Sarah picks up a coat. The tag inside says Sarah. Mike asks: Whose coat is this? Sarah says: It's ___.
questions.hint_zh: 大衣标签写着 Sarah，回答「是我的」
questions.correctSentence: Whose coat is this? It's mine.

questions.sentence: Before school Mum says you still need a white top. ___ your shirt.
After washing, the wet ___ goes on the hanger, not in the drawer.
questions.hint_zh: 洗完后挂起来的是连衣裙

questions.sentence: We leave for the airport tomorrow. Mum tells Amy to ___ my clothes into the suitcase.
questions.hint_zh: 旅行前把衣服装进箱子

questions.sentence: Mike's pants are green. Amy sees green pants with a Dad label. Whose pants are these? They're your father's, not ___.
questions.hint_zh: 裤腰写着 Dad，不是 Mike 的
